subject: Recap and MAP: Northstar pilot scope & decision checkpoints
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara@northstar.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T14:08:00-08:00
Subject: Recap and MAP: Northstar pilot scope & decision checkpoints

Sara — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick write-up so we have a shared view and clear next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Attendees on our side: Dylan Brooks (AE), Aditya Rao (Solutions), Marissa Cole (Customer Success)
Attendees on Northstar: Sara Jenkins (AI Platform), Tom Li (Eng manager — joined late)

Top pain points you called out
- Production latency spikes on inference (esp. bursty traffic between 9–11am PT)
- Cost unpredictability for large-context workflows (search + summarization)
- Need for private VPC deployment and auditability for PHI-sensitive tests

Goals for the pilot
- Validate 99th-pctl latency under typical traffic at 2–4k qps (target: <150ms)
- Measure 30-day unit cost delta vs current infra for 50M tokens/month
- Confirm integration path for your VPC/on-prem requirements and KMS flow

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — milestones, owners, target dates
1) Pilot scope & success criteria defined — Owner: Sara (Northstar) / Dylan (Redwood) — target: 2026-12-17
2) Environment prep (VPC peering, KMS access) — Owner: Tom (Northstar) / Aditya (Redwood) — target: 2026-12-27
3) Pilot kickoff (1-week smoke + 3-week load run) — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Tom (Northstar) — target: 2027-01-03
4) Interim evaluation (metrics review: latency, error rate, cost) — Owner: Marissa / Sara — target: 2027-01-24
5) Procurement & contract sign (PO or SOW approval) — Owner: procurement@northstar.ai / Dylan — target: 2027-02-07
6) Production cutover decision (go/no-go) — Steering committee (Sara, Tom, Head of Ops, Dylan) — target: 2027-02-14

Decision process & criteria
- Pilot metrics meet latency and cost targets (see goals above).
- Security/compliance checklist completed (VPC, KMS, audit logs).
- Procurement issues resolved: pricing and committed capacity approved.

Immediate asks from our side
- Please confirm primary procurement contact (email) and whether you need an MSA or a PO-first flow.
- Confirm that the target dates above look feasible; we can slide environment prep by one week if Tom needs more time.

Attachments included (first pass):
- Northstar_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners)
- Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf (technical scope + pricing placeholder)

If that all looks right I will update the MAP with Tom as an owner for environment prep and push the SOW into DocuSign.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192 | dylan@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2026-12-14T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap and MAP: Northstar pilot scope & decision checkpoints

Thanks — this is a helpful recap. A few quick clarifications:

- Procurement contact is Tom Li (tom.li@northstar.ai) — he handles POs for infra pilots.
- We want to shift the environment prep target to 2026-12-30 to allow our infra team two extra weeks (holiday calendar impact).
- For the procurement milestone, we prefer SOW-first + internal PO; can you push the SOW into DocuSign so Tom can review with finance?

A couple of small edits on success criteria:
- Add error-rate goal: <1% 5xx during steady-state run.
- Add requirement for audit logs retention settings (90 days) for the pilot.

We are comfortable with the pilot length you proposed (1 + 3 weeks) — looking forward to concrete dates after we align on prep.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara@northstar.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@northstar.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@northstar.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap and MAP: Northstar pilot scope & decision checkpoints — updated MAP and next steps

Thanks for the quick turn, Sara. Per your ask I updated the MAP and shifted environment prep to 2026-12-30. Summary of changes and immediate next steps below.

Updated MAP highlights
- Environment prep (VPC peering, KMS role grant, audit log settings retention=90d) — Owner: Tom Li (Northstar) / Aditya Rao (Redwood) — new target: 2026-12-30
- Pilot kickoff: 2027-01-03 (unchanged)
- Interim evaluation: 2027-01-24 (unchanged)
- Procurement: SOW-first flow — SOW to DocuSign by 2026-12-20, Tom to circulate to finance; target PO/approved SOW: 2027-02-07

Decision criteria (finalized)
- Latency: 99th-pctl < 150ms during steady-state run
- Error rate: 5xx < 1%
- Cost: per-1M-token unit cost within the pilot threshold we discussed (I put a placeholder in the SOW; we can lock pricing in the SOW)
- Compliance: VPC + KMS access and 90-day audit logs verified

Concrete asks from me before EOW (2026-12-20)
1) Tom: please confirm procurement contact details and sign-off path for SOW review.
2) Tom / infra: confirm the VPC peering window you prefer between 12/27–12/30 and the person who will accept the peering request.
3) Sara: confirm the steering committee members who will sign the final go/no-go (name + role).

I've attached the updated MAP (Northstar_MAP_v1.xlsx — v1.1) and a slightly revised SOW with a pricing placeholder and the DocuSign link. If everything looks good I'll send the DocuSign envelope to Tom and your finance team.

Next meeting suggestion: 30-minute tech-sync (Aditya + Tom + 1 infra engineer) — propose 2026-12-21 at 10am PT. Tell me if that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks all — looking forward to moving this to kickoff.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192 | dylan@redwoodinference.com
